content_html:
watched #BegumJaan ….. you know that you are watching a Great Movie when even Chunkey Pandey gets a meatier role and man he is full scary as Kabir…

and what a superb movie it is full of bold emotions and rustic dialoges with Top notch BGM and excellent acting from each n every artist….._/\_

You dont need great stunts or action episodes it all takes great dialoges and superb music to create scenes which give goosebumps….

and Man…..if Kangana is called the Queen of Bollywood then Vidya is her Begum Jaan!!!!!!!

Not sure about the comercial success of the movie as the so called family audience may not watch the so called bold content…..but will surely create an impact on the audience.

PS : I havent watched the original bengali version
